name: Innkeeper Norman
summary: Innkeeper Norman keeps the Trade Quarter tavern ready for travelers in the Undercity. The quiet, diligent Forsaken offers Horde travelers rest, hearthstone bindings, and food for the living and the dead.

sections.title: Hospitality in the Sewers
sections.body: Beneath Lordaeron's ruined capital, Innkeeper Norman tends the main tavern in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Emissaries, mercenaries, and adventurers passing through the Forsaken stronghold find lodging there. Travelers come to bind their hearthstones, share news from across Azeroth, or prepare for journeys into the Plaguelands.

sections.title: Festive Eccentricities
sections.body: Innkeeper Norman sells provisions and manages rooms through most of the year. During Hallow's End, he joins the holiday revelry and asks adventurous patrons for peculiar displays, such as clucking like a chicken. Those who oblige can earn holiday treats like Undercity mints.

faq.q: Where can I find Innkeeper Norman?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Norman keeps the main tavern along the southern curve of the Undercity's inner ring, in the Trade Quarter.

faq.q: What services does Innkeeper Norman provide?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Norman offers rooms, hearthstone bindings, and food and drink suited to the living and the undead. Travelers can also rest there and earn rest while away.

faq.q: Why does Norman ask patrons to cluck like a chicken?
faq.answer: During Hallow's End, Innkeeper Norman asks patrons to cluck like a chicken as part of the holiday trickery. Adventurers who swallow their pride can earn special holiday mints.

faq.q: Is Norman related to Innkeeper Bates?
faq.answer: No kinship between Innkeeper Norman and Innkeeper Bates is known, and neither mentions the other in life or undeath. Their shared name is a playful nod to Norman Bates from the film Psycho.

angles.text: For living Horde allies, Innkeeper Norman's tavern offers a secure place to rest and recover in the otherwise unwelcoming fortress beneath the Undercity.
As a Forsaken, you can rest at Innkeeper Norman's gathering place in the heart of the Trade Quarter between assignments for the Dark Lady.
